findings.issue: MSG-P4-001 row now gives a new meaning and message text, but the standard holds another meaning, so the story row must not change until a new ID exists. Row reverted.
Marked Resolved, but the FSD meaning conflicts with the cross-document ruling R-10884 on the same ID. Now Cross-document.
Story claims a data steward confirmed BR9 classification under section 10. No source states this; the item and section reference are unsupported.

Checked-fields path and CheckedField shapes are invented; GAP-1020 says the reader, its operation and names are absent from every source.
The word daily for the re-drive is not in any source; only the re-drive time of day is open.
